device.description: 8-bit 30 MSPS pipelined ADC with internal reference, power-down and 3-state CMOS parallel outputs (3 V / 5 V)
device.note: ads930.pdf (SBAS059A) p.2-3 specifications (digital inputs VIH 2.0 V, start conversion on the rising clock edge, 5-clock latency, straight offset binary, OE 3-state enable 40 ns / disable 10 ns, +VS 2.7-5.25 V), p.4 pin configuration and descriptions, timing diagram (t2 new data delay 12 ns max), p.11 power-down (Pwrdn high = power-down, outputs 3-state), Table I coding (bipolar zero = 10000000), digital outputs (OE high = 3-state, LVDD output driver supply)

pages: p.2-3 (specifications), p.4 (pinout, pin descriptions, timing diagram), p.10-11 (clock, digital outputs, power-down, Table I coding, supplies)
notModeled: analog input, internal reference and ladder bypass (LpBy, LnBy, 1VREF, CM): the result is always the bipolar-zero code 80h (straight offset binary, IN = 1.5 V common mode)
pipeline latency of 5 clock cycles (the code is constant); clock period (33 ns to 100 us) and duty-cycle limits, aperture delay
Pwrdn (active high, internal pull-down): power-down sets the digital outputs to 3-state in the device; the model only stops conversions (the outputs keep driving the constant code)
OE and Pwrdn internal 50 kOhm pull-downs (a floating pin reads active OE / inactive Pwrdn in the device; the model reads Z as inactive for OE)

supplies: +VS 2.7-5.25 V powers the core and the CLK / OE / Pwrdn inputs (VIH 2.0 V); LVDD supplies only the output drivers (range not specified; outputs swing to LVDD); +VS is listed under analog so LVDD is the digital supply, vcc = the +VS range
pin 24 is the complementary input (IN with an overbar); pin 12 Bit 1 is the MSB, pin 5 Bit 8 the LSB
OE 3-state enable / disable times (40 / 10 ns max)
